subject: Money
title: IPO Frenzies
description: Learn IPO Frenzies in one minute.

hook.text: WeWork filed to IPO at $47 billion in 2019. The prospectus revealed billions in losses and the plan collapsed.

buildup.text: In hot markets, companies rush to go public. IPO windows open when investors are euphoric and prices are forgiving.

discovery.text: First-day IPO pops benefit insiders and underwriters. Retail investors who buy at the open often overpay.

twist.text: Many 2021 IPOs are now 80% below their listing price. The IPO window slammed shut in 2022 as rates rose.

climax.text: IPO frenzy is a bubble indicator. When unproven companies go public easily, euphoria has replaced scrutiny.

punchline.text: The best time to IPO is the worst time to buy.

quiz.question: Why is a surge in IPOs considered a bubble indicator?
options: It means the economy is healthy
Euphoria has replaced scrutiny for unproven companies
